q: 我10月8号跟红杉的会，提醒还开着吗？
reply:
I don't see an active reminder for the 10月8号红杉会议 anymore. The history shows you decided to push Redwood to the next round and focus only on BlueRun this round. On 6 Oct you told me to decline them for now. Then their meeting got moved to 20 Oct, and you asked to clear that week, then later asked to push it off too.

So no, the reminder was effectively canceled when you decided to defer Redwood. I don't have one set.

But today is 1 Nov — that meeting date has already passed anyway.

Speaking of which: today is 1 Nov. I have a reminder for you to do the quarterly review. Want me to pull together the key numbers first?
